findings.claim: One SEO038 finding is emitted for each stylesheet that holds @font-face, so two stylesheets give two findings.
findings.spec_quote: SEO038 | info | a `<link rel="stylesheet">` resolves to an existing site file containing `@font-face`, and no `<link>` has `rel` including `preload` with `as="font"`

findings.claim: A robots rule `Disallow: /secret$` wrongly matches the indexed page /secrets/ (the $ is ignored, so it behaves as a prefix).
findings.spec_quote: SEO026 | error | ... a trailing `$` anchors the end, otherwise prefix match

findings.claim: SEO041 is reported for an object inside @graph although only top-level objects are covered, and the top-level object has an @context.
findings.spec_quote: SEO041 | warn | JSON-LD parses | a top-level object (the JSON itself, or each element if it is a list) has no `@context`

findings.claim: The content checks are skipped for 404.html, so a 404 page without an h1 gets no SEO030.
findings.spec_quote: Content checks (SEO030 to SEO052) run on every page, the 404 included.

findings.claim: A relative og:image gets SEO016 (not checked) where SEO014 should be reported.
findings.spec_quote: SEO016 ... Fires when: it is not an absolute http(s):// URL ... 'not checked'

findings.claim: A robots rule `Disallow: /admin/$` is matched as a prefix, so a page below /admin/ is reported.
findings.spec_quote: SEO026 | error | ... a trailing `$` anchors the end, otherwise prefix match

findings.claim: Two images without alt give one SEO033 finding, not one per image.
